name: Holix
description: Server plugin for the Holix Play client. Every Holix profile is a hidden Jellyfin user, so watch state, Next Up and parental controls work natively on the server. Age ratings (all, 7+, 13+, 16+, 18+) become Jellyfin parental limits (TR/US/DE rating systems), profile sessions can require a PIN verified by holix-cloud (Ed25519-signed, single-use proof), and guest profiles keep no watch history.
overview: Holix Play profiles: household profiles, parental controls, guest mode

versions.changelog: - Age thresholds now use the band's age, identical across rating systems (TR/US/DE); the rating system only selects the label. A 7+ profile now sees US TV-Y7 in every system. - `POST /Holix/Household/Link` returns the updated household (same body as `GET /Holix/Household`). - New `PUT` / `DELETE /Holix/Profiles/{id}/Image`: profile pictures are stored as the Jellyfin user image. - The profile image directory is validated to stay inside Jellyfin's user configuration directory. - holix-cloud URL defaults to `https://api.holixplay.com`.
